items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: That was Jimmy Davis' brother playing the drum

ctx.x: Oh, this Davis, you said his brother was a piano player? Before you were telling us about it.
Yeah, Jimmy. Jimmy Davis. That was Jimmy Davis' brother playing the drum at the computer with the power of this.
Was he akin to Robert Davis? I think that's his name.
